results.name: the card: one bright colour on every line (core #ff1fd4 on a dark edge), a solid line with no halo, glow or filter, round caps and joins, the width the engine sets (16 pt on the plan on a desktop, 4 px on the screen on a phone), the zoom and base buttons, Plan on, a legend of one with the dot in the same colour, no colour names, no agent names

detail.sub: The fence closure lines from the project manager's marked plan of 23 Oct 2026, drawn on the 2026 master layout (D001-26003-03) along the footpaths as marked: one bright colour, straight runs, no numbers. Plan or satellite under the lines; pinch, scroll or use the buttons to zoom to 16000%; drag to move; double-tap to zoom in.

results.name: the lines are straight runs that cover the marked streets: few vertices for their length (under 2.2 per 100 pt), no segment shorter than 5 pt, about 5,000 to 5,600 pt in all, and a line within 12 pt of eleven named spots read off the marked plan
at 400% the line is held between 4 and 14 px on the screen (14 px on a desktop: its plan width falls), the same width the engine reports
Satellite: Esri tiles under the lines at the fit zoom (15 to 17), the credit shown, the lines the top layer with the dark edge stronger on imagery
1600% on satellite at the Esplanade: Esri tiles at zoom 19 or 20, the line still 14 px on the screen
16000% on Breaker St on satellite: the view 15 pt wide, Esri tiles at zoom 20 (the sharpest real imagery), a couple of dozen at most
Plan brings the drawing back and empties the satellite layer
